engineWarnings.warn_isf_24h: The ISF 10+2 filing must be submitted at least 24 hours before the goods are loaded at the port of departure.
engineWarnings.warn_brazil_import_licence: A Brazilian import licence (LI) may be required before shipping. Check with the importer.
engineWarnings.warn_nigeria_form_m: Form M (Nigeria) must be obtained by the importer BEFORE the shipment leaves.
engineWarnings.warn_rid_rail: Rail carriage of dangerous goods falls under the RID rules. You need a DG manifest, an MSDS and the RID paperwork from the rail carrier.
engineWarnings.warn_dual_use_licence: A dual-use licence (EU Regulation 2021/821) must be obtained BEFORE the shipment leaves.
engineWarnings.warn_blacklist_cert: The destination customs authority may require a blacklist certificate. Check with a local customs agent.
engineWarnings.warn_legalisation_kig: The invoice and certificate of origin need legalisation by the chamber of commerce and the embassy. Allow 7 to 10 working days.
engineWarnings.warn_psi_leadtime: A pre-shipment inspection (PSI) is required. Allow 3 to 5 working days.
engineWarnings.warn_t2l_sea_eu: A T2L is required for sea transport inside the EU. Without it the goods count as a non-EU import at the destination port.
engineWarnings.warn_sanctions_ru_by_dest: SANCTIONS WARNING: routes to Russia and Belarus fall under EU sanctions. Check the prohibited goods lists in EU Regulation 833/2014 (Russia) and 765/2006 (Belarus) before shipping. Many categories are banned or need a special export authorisation.
engineWarnings.warn_sanctions_ru_by_origin: SANCTIONS WARNING: imports from Russia and Belarus into the EU fall under EU sanctions. Check the prohibited import list before signing the contract.
engineWarnings.warn_ched_p_traces: Importing food into the EU needs a CHED-P pre-notification in TRACES NT at least 24 hours before arrival at the port. The EU importer is responsible for it. The veterinary check at the Border Control Post is mandatory and without a CHED-P the goods are held.
engineWarnings.warn_atp_cold_chain: Food must stay in the cold chain: frozen at a maximum of minus 18°C, chilled at 0 to 4°C. The transport must meet ATP Convention requirements. Attach the data logger temperature record.
engineWarnings.warn_mercosur_ita: The EU-Mercosur agreement (iTA) applies from 1 May 2026. Check the requirements for the new origin certificates, EC Notice 2026/875. An updated certificate of origin format may be required.
engineWarnings.warn_eu_import_sad: Importing into the EU requires a customs declaration (SAD/H1) for release into free circulation, filed by the importer or a licensed customs agent in the destination country. Duty and VAT are charged at clearance.
engineWarnings.warn_eea_customs: Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein are in the EEA but outside the EU customs territory. An EAD is required as for any non-EU export. The EEA agreement removes duty, but the customs formalities still apply.
engineWarnings.warn_atr_turkey: Export to Turkey (EU-TR customs union): industrial goods in free circulation need an A.TR certificate (free circulation status, 0% rate). EUR.1 and EUR-MED cover only agricultural products, coal and steel. Note: the A.TR template is not available in the system yet.
engineWarnings.warn_atr_turkey_agri: Export to Turkey (EU-TR customs union): for agricultural products preferential origin is proved by EUR.1, not by A.TR. The A.TR certificate covers industrial goods in free circulation.
engineWarnings.warn_gsp_form_a_rex: GSP: Form A is being replaced by the statement on origin in the REX system. Check whether the country of dispatch still issues Form A or has already moved to REX.
engineWarnings.warn_rex_export: Export to {{country}}: preferential origin is declared on the invoice (REX system, statement on origin), not through EUR.1. Up to 6,000 EUR any exporter may issue it. Above that, only a registered or approved exporter (REX) may do so.
engineWarnings.warn_rex_import: Import from {{country}} into the EU: the importer can claim a preferential duty rate under the free trade agreement. The exporter must attach a statement on origin to the invoice (REX system). Up to 6,000 EUR any exporter may issue it. Above that, only a registered REX exporter or an approved exporter (AE).
engineWarnings.warn_tir_non_ctc: The route passes through a country outside the Common Transit Convention ({{countries}}). A TIR carnet is required: road transport, a TIR approved vehicle and a customs guarantee. TIR does not cover alcohol or tobacco products.
engineWarnings.warn_ctc_transit: Transit through a Common Transit Convention country ({{countries}}). A T1/T2 transit declaration in NCTS with a customs guarantee is enough, a TIR carnet is not needed.
engineWarnings.warn_rail_transit_non_eu: The rail route passes through a country outside the Common Transit Convention ({{countries}}). A TIR carnet does not apply to rail transport; the third country's own transit procedure is required and must be arranged with the rail carrier.
engineWarnings.warn_document_not_yet_valid: The document "{{document}}" only takes effect on {{date}}. It is not required before that date.
engineWarnings.warn_document_expired: The document "{{document}}" ceased to apply on {{date}}. Check whether another document has replaced it.
